reasoning: On the season so far the Celtics are the stronger team; with home court the Celtics start about 14 points better, in a game of about 220 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Celtics.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Celtics win 88 times in 100, by about 14; most games like this end between 194 and 242 total points.
